verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface, such as an in-app assistant or chat-driven operation of payroll, banking or cash-flow features. The beta Dev Assistant MCP server lets external AI tools reach the Embedded Payroll API and docs, and the CLI is 'agent-friendly', but both are developer building blocks that belong to the separate MCP-server and CLI stories. Neither earns credit for natural-language operation of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
